name: ego-lite
description: The fastest browser for AI agents to run browser automation, built for sharing your logged-in browser state with your AI agents, like Codex or Claude Code, without disturbing you. Zero cost, zero config.

latest_release.name: v2.2.0
latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v2.2.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* perf(ego-browser): collapse click actionability checks into one injected call by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/534
### Fixes
* fix(ego-browser): isolate default screenshot paths across runs in the shared Node process by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/492
### Documentation
* docs: sync README benchmarks and comparison table with lite.ego.app, add a Windows download by @braxtonROSE4 in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/486
### Other Changes
* fix(ego-browser): scope page ledgers by browser instance by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/466
* build(ego-browser): unwrap soft-wrapped prose in the printed usage guide by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/469
* refactor(skill): split into entry Skill and versioned usage guide by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/449
* fix(ego-browser): report stuck requests on networkidle timeouts and stop e2e budget cascades by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/473
* fix(ego-browser): remind agents to release task spaces they still control by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/474
* fix(ego-browser): list and claim user spaces that were never renamed by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/475
* ci: allow release branches cut from dev to target main by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/477
* fix(ego-browser): resume and detach every auto-attached non-frame target by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/479
* fix(ego-browser): enable Ego automation hooks on every Page session by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/480
* feat(skill): render a usage guide per operating system by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/481
* Revert "fix(ego-browser): remind agents to release task spaces they still control" by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/489
* feat(ego-browser): flag content outside the viewport in default snapshots by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/494
* fix(ego-browser): fall back when wheel input cannot bring a target into view by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/497
* perf(ego-browser): drop fixed settle delays from actions and fail fast on idle pages by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/510
* refactor(ego-browser): use a six-digit suffix for default screenshot names by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/511
* ci: add Codex PR review workflow by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/526
* fix(ego-browser): retry transient rename errors when writing page ledgers by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/531
* fix(ego-browser): bound session setup waits and name an unresponsive Page by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/532
* fix(ci): restore Star History updates and round Y axis bounds by @yarin-zhang in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/572
* fix(ego-browser): let finish() close the blank anchor tab left by the last Page close by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/575
* fix(plugins): bring agent plugin packages up to current host specs by @WUXM5 in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/576
* fix(ego-browser): retry a snapshot whose capture straddles a document commit by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/585
* fix(ego-browser): share one guid-named download directory across Pages and processes by @joway in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/587
* fix(plugins): keep published npm packages valid without republishing by @WUXM5 in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/588
* feat(plugins): publish the npm packages under the @ego-lite scope by @WUXM5 in https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite/pull/589
* docs(readme): replace the top banner image by @braxtonR
